description: Startup code for ARM Cortex-M3 microcontroller, including reset handler, default interrupt handler, and vector table for an AUTOSAR-based embedded system.

methods.name: Reset_Handler
methods.description: Initial startup routine that copies data segment from flash to RAM, zeroes the BSS segment, and calls main.

methods.name: Default_Handler
methods.description: Infinite loop used as default interrupt handler for unexpected interrupts.
